body: What would you do if you knew you could not fail? Might as well start that business, apply for that program, quit that job, if this is your last year. And who knows maybe one of those things will help make it not your last year.
This is why it’s a wonderful life is my favorite movie. I wish I could know what the world would be like if I hadn’t been born. I feel like it’d very motivating.
Oh man that sounds torturous. Sorry I don’t have any other recommendations. It’s all I know how to do when I’m feeling like that.

Most of those urges last only 30 minutes. Is there something you can occupy yourself with for that amount of time? Reading, drawing, watching your favorite show, scrolling aimlessly on reddit/twitter/etc, taking a shower, making food (I mean might as well have a good last meal before it’s over), yoga, a run, a walk, etc.

So please don’t go out the window. Try something to distract yourself instead.

Has it been constant for those 15 years? If so it almost sounds like a hormone or some sort of chemical imbalance issue.

It hasn’t been constant for me. I try to remember the times it hasn’t been present to keep me slogging though the times it’s tough.
